sentences.japanese: 我が軍は敵の防御を突破した。
sentences.english: Our army broke through the enemy defenses.

sentences.japanese: 我が軍は絶えずゲリラの攻撃を受けた。
sentences.english: Our troops were constantly attacked by the guerrillas.

sentences.japanese: 我が軍はその王国を不意打ちにした。
sentences.english: Our army took the kingdom by surprise.

sentences.japanese: わが軍は敵に夜襲をかけた。
sentences.english: Our army attacked the enemy during the night.

sentences.japanese: わが軍は敵に痛撃を与えた。
sentences.english: We gave the enemy a drubbing.
